summary: 2026 UCI Women's WorldTeam kit, developed in collaboration with Nimbl and read off the team's official webshop replica photos: Visma and Lease a Bike on chest and back, Cervélo on the chest, Nimbl by the collar and on the cuffs, Rabobank down the side panel and on the shorts, SRAM on the sleeves, Jumbo and nimbl.cc on the lower back, and the L-logo of premium partner Founders of Loyalty on the lower back. The 'yellow b.' mark is the team's own company name, not an outside sponsor. sponsorsComplete is false: the black 'e' marks on both shoulders are unidentified (no team partner page names them), so the sponsor list cannot be confirmed complete.
